"<PROGRAM_FILES>\\POWERS~1\\7\\pwsh.exe" -Command 'New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path handoff -Force | Out-Null
Copy-Item -LiteralPath analyst-report.txt -Destination handoff/analyst-report.txt
$crates = @(
    @{name='"'A'; price=80; kits=18; mats=10; friday="'$true},
    @{name='"'B'; price=95; kits=12; mats=15; friday="'$true},
    @{name='"'C'; price=70; kits=16; mats=8; friday="'$true},
    @{name='"'D'; price=90; kits=14; mats=12; friday="'$true},
    @{name='"'E'; price=60; kits=10; mats=15; friday="'$false}
)
$pairs = @(for ($i=0; $i -lt $crates.Count; $i++) {
    for ($j=$i+1; $j -lt $crates.Count; $j++) {
        $a=$crates[$i]; $b=$crates[$j]
        $price=$a.price+$b.price; $kits=$a.kits+$b.kits; $mats=$a.mats+$b.mats
        $budgetOk=$price -le 180; $quantityOk=($kits -ge 30 -and $mats -ge 20); $fridayOk=$a.friday -and $b.friday
        [ordered]@{pair=$a.name+'"'+'+"'$b.name; price=$price; kits=$kits; mats=$mats; budget_ok=$budgetOk; quantity_ok=$quantityOk; friday_ok=$fridayOk; qualifies=($budgetOk -and $quantityOk -and $fridayOk)}
    }
})
[ordered]@{pairs=$pairs; selected_pair='"'C+D'} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 | Set-Content -LiteralPath handoff/pair-checks.json -Encoding utf8
@'

"'$sourceHash=(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath analyst-report.txt).Hash

Write-Output '"'Verified: original evidence copy is byte-identical; 10 pairs; C+D is cheapest of 3 eligible pairs.'"
